paper.title: High surface area microporous carbon materials for cryogenic hydrogen storage synthesized using new template-based and activation-based approaches

defaults.verified_by: Agent B (sonnet, independent re-derivation of Tables 1-2 + methods): 25 rows, 0 numeric disputes. Table 1 (7 silica-templated carbons N-C-1..4 / B-C-1..3 at 77 K, 1.13 bar): BET (1363/1995/1900/1329/1654/1510/1497), Langmuir, micropore area, total and micropore pore volumes, and H2 wt% (1.42/2.01/1.93/1.39/1.62/1.45/1.32) all confirmed. Table 2 (18 KOH-activated carbons C-1..C-18 at 77 K, 40 bar): BET and excess H2 wt% confirmed. uptake_type=excess. Calibration WITHHELD ('calibrated volumes of H2', UHP H2/He, but no explicit void-volume or blank-correction described -- thinner than HYC-0049's He-pycnometry + background subtraction). Tiers: Table 1 rows A (9/10 = BET&class 2 + method 2 + T&P 1 + uptake_type 1 + purity 1 (HF template-removal etch) + Chahine 2); Table 2 rows B (7-8/10, no purity credit, no calibration). Agent C: populated langmuir_surface_area_m2_g on S1-S7 (1902/2711/2666/1815/2217/2043/2012 -- the field exists; the values had been recorded only in material_description text) and corrected the t1tex note that claimed 'no schema field'. HF-etch purification_method KEPT on the templated carbons (template removal = purification, consistent with the committed HYC-0049 ZTC precedent); Agent B's objection that template-etch is not sample purification is a legitimate corpus-wide convention question, logged for a future pass rather than applied to one paper. Final: 7 A / 18 B.

notes.method: volumetric method: low-P on a Micromeritics ASAP 2010 (H2), high-P/77 K on a cryostat-attached PCTPro-2000; 'calibrated volumes of hydrogen gas', UHP H2 and He. No explicit void-volume or blank-correction description -> calibration point WITHHELD (thinner than HYC-0049's He-pycnometry+background subtraction) [flag Agent B]
notes.t1: Table 1 aerosol-assisted one-step template method: TEOS (+colloidal silica for bimodal) silica template, sucrose carbonised 900 C, 10% HF etch of the silica -> templated_carbon / template_synthesis; HF = purification_method (HYC-0049 ZTC precedent). Measured at 77 K and 1.13 bar (low-pressure point, not the saturation max).
notes.t1tex: bet_surface_area=BET; Langmuir area also reported (langmuir_surface_area_m2_g); micropore_surface_area=micropore area col; total_pore_volume (P/P0>0.97 single point) and micropore_volume both recorded with pore_volume_method=unspecified (paper states BJH/DFT for pore SIZES, not explicitly for the volumes), probe N2
notes.t2: Table 2 chemical activation: phenol-formaldehyde oligomer + KOH (ratio/temp/time varied), carbonised/activated, HCl+DI wash (activation workup, NOT purification) -> activated_carbon / chemical_activation. Measured at 77 K and 40 bar (saturation).
notes.t2tex: Table 2 reports only BET + excess H2 at 77 K/40 bar (no pore volume column).
